Meet Yumberries Slippery Rock

Frozen yogurt paradise

Yumberries Slippery Rock is a self-serve frozen yogurt and dessert shop in downtown Slippery Rock, PA, next to Slippery Rock University. Its own description promises frozen yogurt with certified live cultures in every bite, with 12 flavors and over 40 toppings.

Fill your cup and pay by the ounce. There is 10% off for SRU students, faculty, and staff with a valid SRU ID. The shop's own trifold carries its slogan: 'Come Get Your Swirl On!'
